decisions.reason: Certified gasketed plate exchangers for HVAC sit close to the core offer, and the growing industry and the firm's hiring give it enough slack to carry them while results are still uncertain.
The box cooler is reported as having a major market share in water cooling systems, so it meets the aspiration and gives no reason for problemistic search.
The marine cooling unit has its own page, shows the firm is committed to it, and complements the successful marine box cooler line.
The compact oil cooler builds on the established offer, and with no evidence of a shortfall and slack available, there is little cause to drop it, though it is only mentioned briefly.
Finned tubes for air coolers are a core component presented on their own page, so they are likely to meet expectations within the growing business.
Enhanced tubes reflect the firm's in-house R&D and efficiency goals, and slack lets the firm keep them despite limited evidence on results.
